summary: This broad RTCPeerConnection update improves frame handling, InsertDTMF standards compliance, ICE restart behavior, codec preferences, bundled early-media reception, and WebRTC statistics. It also modernizes codec and RTP header-extension storage, updates frame-count telemetry names, restores H.264 telemetry, keeps RTCDataChannel alive with its peer connection, and moves stats history into a dedicated WebRTC store for more dependable diagnostics.
